newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on weak ringgit.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on weak ringgit.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Oct (3rd pos)1,162 rgt/tonne July (south) 1,205
Open/Hi/Low 1,156/1,164/1,156 Prev close 1,192.50
Prev settlement 1,154 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Closed higher on continuous weakening of the ringgit. Speculative buying was main feature with little contribution from fundamentals. Immediate range seen at 1,150-1,180. Currency expected to be main factor in Friday's trade, although July 1-25 export figures from cargo surveyors on Friday could determine direction.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Active and followed futures.
A renewed call to impose seasonal duties on edible oil imports and starts futures trading in India also went unnoticed in the local market, said traders.
They said Malaysia's July 1-25 export figures, to be released by cargo surveyors SGS (M) Sdn Bhd on Friday, could help direction.
"The exports are expected to be higher than the previous corresponding period," said another trader. "So I guess we'll have a firm market unless the currency strengthens."
At the close, the benchmark third-position October futures contract ended up eight ringgit at 1,162 ringgit ($439.15).
The contract fell to as low as 1,156 during the day.
Physicals were as active as futures. July (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,205 ringgit a tonne against bids at 1,202.50. It was traded from 1,200 to 1,202.50.
July (central) saw offers at 1,195 ringgit against bids at 1,190. It saw trade at 1,190.
Aug (south) was offered at 1,205 ringgit against bids at 1,202.50. It was traded at 1,202.50.
Aug (central) was offered at 1,195 against bids at 1,190. It was traded at 1,190.
In refined palm oil, Aug RBD palm oil was offered at $482.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia. Sept and Oct/Nov/Dec saw offers at $480.
Aug RBD palm olein was offered at $520, Sep at $515 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $512.50. Aug was traded at $517.50, Sept at $515 and $512.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $510.
Aug RBD palm stearin was offered at $362.50 and Sept at $362.50. Oct/Nov/Dec saw offers at $362.50. Aug was traded at $360 and $362.50.
Aug/Sep RBD palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $290.
-- K. Baranee Krishnaan (603-201 4813) ($1=2.6460 ringgit)
